jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Transformers are one of the most important components for energy supply in high and medium voltage networks. Reliable energy transmission is the decisive criterion for our customers. In your daily work, you will develop optimal transformer solutions together with our customers to meet current challenges. A holistic approach, consisting of optimal product design, the selection of suitable monitoring systems, and the definition of tailored service concepts, is always at the forefront.     

How You’ll Make an Impact
 

* Conducting feasibility studies for transformers, as well as creating preliminary transformer designs to determine maximum dimensions and weights 
* Selecting suitable monitoring systems and presenting them to customers 
* Include service and monitoring systems proposition on transformers solutions and presenting them to customers 
* Optimizing interfaces with other products, such as the connection of gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear 
* Collaborating with regional sales, factories, and monitoring- and service departments  
* Capture and translate market trends, customer requirements, and emerging technologies into actionable inputs for product development and portfolio strategy 
* Act as a key technical interface between customers, regional sales teams, and R&D, ensuring alignment of market needs with product capabilities and innovation roadmaps 
* Support strategic customer discussions by providing consultative expertise on transformer solutions within complex grid and substation applications 
* Drive standardization and modularization concepts for transformer design and interfaces, enabling simplification of engineering, reduction of lead times, and improved scalability 
* Identify opportunities to optimize production footprint and maximize factory capacity utilization, balancing customization needs with standardized product approaches 
* Contribute to the definition of global technical positioning and differentiators in competitive bids and key pursuits 
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to improve offer quality, reduce risk, and enhance execution feasibility across regions and factories 
* Includes AI into your daily work to increase productivity and maximize outcome Support the development of guidelines, tools, and best practices for technical sales engineering within ADCE 

What You Bring

* Complete university degree in electrical engineering, energy technology, high voltage technology, or comparable courses of study 
* Long term experience in creating offer designs for transformers, or comparable activities in product management, development, or service of transformers
* Analytical skills and a systematic, analytical and goal-oriented approach to solving complex tasks 
* Experience with monitoring systems for transformers and transformer service Solid commercial knowledge, as well as strong team and communication skills 
* Fluent in German and English. Additional languages are a plus Strong understanding of global energy market dynamics, customer segments, and grid trends, particularly in transmission and substation applications 
* Proven experience in interfacing between technical, commercial, and R&D organizations, ideally in an international environment 
* Ability to combine deep technical expertise with commercial acumen, supporting customer-centric solution development 
* Experience in standardization, product harmonization, or industrialization initiatives within transformer 
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate market insights into product and portfolio improvements 
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across regions, business units, and organizational levels 
* Experience supporting complex tenders or key accounts, including early-stage consulting and positioning 
* High level of ownership, initiative, and ability to work in a global, matrix organization 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

As Engineering Quality Manager (EQM) UAS and EuroDrone (d/f/m) at Airbus Defence and Space, you are responsible for ensuring product quality throughout the entire engineering lifecycle of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and the EuroDrone program. You ensure compliance with quality and development standards, processes, and regulations, contributing significantly to the delivery of reliable and safe products

Duties & Responsibilities:

Quality & Process Assurance:

- Ensure compliance with aerospace and development standards such as EN 9100, ARP4754, DO-178C, and DO-254
- Support development, certification, and airworthiness activities in accordance with EMAR Part 21/145
- Plan and execute audits, process assurance reviews, and quality gates
- Drive preventive quality measures (Right-First-Time, APQP, FMEA)

Engineering Quality Activities:

- Monitor requirements traceability and ensure proper allocation of quality requirements
- Support and assess technical reviews and process assurance activities
- Collaborating with development, systems engineering, and test teams to integrate quality throughout the entire product development process
- Train and raise awareness among the EuroDrone community regarding quality requirements and processes.
- Support tool qualification and verification/testing activities
- Ensure conformity documentation and audit readiness
- Facilitate peer reviews and track quality findings

System, Software & Hardware Assurance:

- Ensure compliant system, software, and hardware plans and development processes
- Monitor software lifecycle and compliance with DO-178C
- Ensure hardware process compliance with DO-254
- Manage non-conformities, deviations, and configuration control
- Supporting the qualification of suppliers and subcontractors

Documentation and Reporting:

- Create and maintain process assurance documents such as SyPAP (System Process Assurance Plan), SyPAD (System Process Assurance Dossier), SQAP (Software Quality Assurance Plan), and HPAP (Hardware Process Assurance Plan).
- Collect and analyze quality data and evidence.
- Create reports and records for quality assurance activities.

Qualifications:

- Degree in engineering, aerospace engineering, or comparable
- Several years of professional experience in quality management, preferably in the defence aerospace environment
- Sound knowledge of quality management standards (e.g., EN 9100, AQAP 2310),
- Experience with process assurance, software quality assurance, and hardware quality assurance.
Knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (e.g., ARP4754A, DO-178, DO-330, DO-254).
- Knowledge of relevant defence aviation regulations (e.g., EMAR Part 21/145) would be a plus
- Experience with Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and/or large-scale aviation programmes is an advantage.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
- Ability to understand and interpret complex technical information.
- Knowledge of conducting audits and reviews.
- Ability to work independently and structured
- Fluent English skills in speaking and writing. German or Spanish skills would be a plus

jobs.occupation: Head of Innovation Delivery & Business Intelligence (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Innovationsmanagement)
jobs.description:
Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest integrated manufacturers of building materials and solutions with leading market positions in cement, aggregates, and ready-mixed concrete. We are represented in more than 50 countries with around 51,000 employees at almost 3,000 locations.

At the centre of our actions lies the responsibility for the environment. As the front runner on the path to carbon neutrality and circular economy in the building materials industry, we are working on sustainable building materials and solutions for the future. We enable new opportunities for our customers through digitalisation.

We are seeking to recruit a Head of Innovation Delivery and Business Intelligence (f/m/d) for our Global Research & Development and Innovation (GRDI) department.

The Head of Innovation Delivery and Business Intelligence plays a central role in shaping, steering, and accelerating Heidelberg Materials' Group Innovation Strategy. The position is accountable for translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution across a portfolio of high impact innovation initiatives, spanning short-, mid-, and long- term market horizons.

This is a leadership role suited for a professional with a strong strategic mindset and hands‑on delivery experience, who has experience at the intersection of innovation, analytics, and complex stakeholder environments. It combines portfolio management, insight generation, and organizational influence, with direct exposure to Group leadership and external partners.

In this position you lead a team of 4-8 professionals, including oversight of startup and ecosystem engagements, and act as a trusted partner to Senior Leaders across R&D, Innovation, Operations, and Corporate functions.

The position is based in Leimen, near our headquarters in Heidelberg, Germany, and reports to the position Vice President of Global R&D and Innovation.

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE

Innovation Portfolio Leadership & Execution

- Lead and steer the Group Innovation portfolio across short-, mid-, and long- term market horizons, ensuring alignment with the Group Innovation Strategy
- Provide fact-based decision support for innovation initiatives leveraging market, regulatory, supply chain, and IP insights and proactively disseminate relevant insights across the Group
- Ensure disciplined execution of innovation initiatives, including timely delivery and clear accountability
- Drive portfolio prioritization and resource allocation through structured review and decision cycles
- Enable efficient collaboration across internal and external stakeholders and deliver concise, decision relevant updates to senior management

Team Leadership & Capability Building

- Lead and develop a team of 4-8 professionals, fostering a performance oriented and collaborative culture
- Set priorities, coach structured problem-solving and ensure capability building aligned with future needs

Startup & Ecosystem Engagement

- Oversee startup collaborations and innovation ecosystem partnerships, ensuring strategic fit, scalability, and business impact
- Collaborate with startups, technology and service providers, academic partners, and domain experts to identify opportunities, manage risks, and enable knowledge transfer
- Maintain an insight on significant developments within the sector, and disseminate knowledge within the Group in a timely manner

Innovation Culture & External Representation

- Strengthen the organization's innovation culture through high-visibility initiatives such as innovation challenges and hackathons
- Represent Heidelberg Materials in relevant industry forums and associations, coordinating closely with internal stakeholders

Governance & Financial Oversight

- Own and continuously evolve a robust performance and governance framework for R&D and innovation initiatives
- Lead requirements related to research grants, public funding and other financial incentives, including R&D tax schemes
- Design, maintain, and refine best‑in‑class reporting tools and dashboards for innovation projects, covering resource allocation, budgets, spend tracking, and personnel time
- Oversee contractual topics, including IP management and competition law

YOUR PROFILE

- University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Innovation, Engineering, Science or related field; advanced degree to be considered most positively
- Proven experience in innovation management, strategy execution, or complex project delivery, organizational planning, ideally in a corporate or consulting environment; experience with using state-of-the-art digital tools for innovation management will be seen as a plus
- Demonstrated ability to translate market signals, technical insights, and operational complexity into strategic decisions and an innovation portfolio
- Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills, with confidence engaging senior executives and leaders across diverse functions
- High analytical rigor combined with a bias for impact and action
- Proven ability to work fluently in English, additional languages are an advantage
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex topics clearly to diverse audiences
- Comfortable navigating complex, ambiguous environments and aligning multiple interests across regions and functions
- Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 5-10%)

OUR OFFER

We are convinced that only those who successfully realize their personal goals can also fully contribute professionally. That's why we offer you attractive benefits, such as:

- Flexible working time models with up to 50% remote working within Germany
- 30 vacation days plus additional special vacation days
- Attractive compensation with profit share/bonus, Christmas, and vacation payment
- Multiple learning & development options: support of job-related further training, various technical and leadership development program
- JobTicket, JobBike and further special conditions and discounts for e.g., gyms
- Company fitness room, various sports classes, health, and prevention campaigns
- Individual onboarding with buddy program as well as various networking initiatives (Network of Women, International Network etc.)
- Modern office building in Leimen, close to vineyards, featuring ergonomic desks and height‑adjustable workstations
- Subsidized on‑site canteen offering a variety of meal options
- Free on‑site parking for cars and bicycles, with charging options available

... and much more.

Nothing provides more motivation than success. Da Vinci Engineering is highly committed to ensuring the own employees' success. Become a part of us!
